matrix.unmapped: {count} dimension is mapped to no item and will therefore produce no score: | {count} dimensions are mapped to no item and will therefore produce no score:
matrix.allMapped: Every dimension is mapped to at least one item.
matrix.caption: Items × dimensions. Rows are items, columns are dimensions; a check mark means that item measures that dimension.
matrix.noItems: This version has no items yet.
matrix.heading: Item × dimension matrix

ledger.caption: Items in this version. Tab moves right; the last row adds an item.
ledger.captionFrozen: This version's snapshot — the text frozen at publish, not today's bank text.
ledger.empty: No items yet. Add one in the last row, or paste several at once.

error.noScale: This instrument has no scale yet. Create one in the Scales & dimensions tab first.
error.badCode: A code may contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error.duplicateCode: That code is already used in this version.

ledger.heading: Items

bank.lead: Scales and dimensions belong to the instrument, not to a version — both stay editable even when a version is published, because that version keeps its own snapshot.
bank.scaleCaption: Every item uses one scale. Its anchor points are the text a participant reads.
bank.name: Name
bank.noScales: No scales yet. An item cannot be created until at least one scale exists.
bank.dimensionCaption: One item may measure several dimensions at once, including dimensions of different kinds.
bank.noDimensions: No dimensions yet. An item with no dimension produces no score, and the version cannot be published.

error.badCode: A code may contain only lowercase letters, digits and underscores.
error.duplicateScale: That scale code is already used.
error.tooFewAnchors: A scale needs at least two labelled anchor points.
error.anchorNotNumeric: Every anchor point needs a numeric value.
error.anchorValueRepeated: Anchor point values must not repeat.
error.duplicateDimension: That dimension code is already used.

publish.heading: Review before publishing
publish.noSource: This version is not derived from another, so there is nothing to compare against. All of it is new.
publish.stemDriftHeading: Item text changed since the source version ({count})
publish.stemDriftLead: The item codes are the same, the wording is not. A published version keeps its own old wording; what changed is what this version asks.
publish.acknowledge: I have reviewed {changes} in this version and take responsibility for the decision.
publish.tickToArm: Tick the confirmation to arm publishing.
publish.immutableNotice: Once published, this version becomes immutable (FR-005). Any change after that needs a new version.

frozen.published: This version is published and cannot be changed.
frozen.retired: This version is retired and cannot be changed.

blocker.wrong-status: A version must be in review before it can be published.
blocker.unmappedItems: {count} item is mapped to no dimension: {codes}. | {count} items are mapped to no dimension: {codes}.
blocker.not-acknowledged: The change confirmation must be ticked before publishing.

instrument.editable: Version {version} is {status} and can still be changed.

failure.review: The status could not be changed to review.

translation.lead: Each translation sits beside the text it renders. What you edit here is the translation; the original is edited in the Items and Scales & dimensions tabs.
translation.itemsCaption: The authored text on the left, its translation on the right. An untranslated item still renders in Indonesian for the reader.
translation.noItems: This version has no items to translate yet.
translation.scalesLead: A scale is translated whole — its name and every one of its anchor points. Anchor values cannot be changed here, because changing one changes what is measured rather than how it reads.
translation.anchorLabelFor: Translation of anchor point {value} on scale {code}
